_note: T-268 Mixamo pack manifest. file = stem of build/graphics/staging/mixamo/<who>/<file>.fbx; name = clip name in the packed library; loop = loop the clip; window = [start, end] seconds of the source to keep (optional); hips_xz = 'keep' (default), 'rest' (pin hips X/Z in place, at the window's first frame) or 'loop' (remove the net travel so the end meets the start); fix_loop = blend the end pose back onto the start pose so a cut window loops without a pop (loop_blend seconds); hips_yaw = 'strip' (T-272: take the hips' turn out of a turning clip, frame by frame; the pack notes the degrees in the clip's meta turn_degrees); hips_y = 'loop' (T-272: take the net rise out of a stairs clip); lower = metres to lower the hips by, the legs bent to it with the ankles kept (T-272: the crouch clips, to fit the crouched view); mirror = pack the clip's mirror image (left and right swapped; T-271: the bed is left on either side); max_slide (manager clips played in place) = fail the pack if a planted foot drifts more than this many metres a cycle. T-268: the slash keeps its hips (pinning them made the planted feet slide 15-26 cm a chop; kept, 6-11 cm, as the source itself).
